```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
library(readr)
library(here)
```

##Pull in metadata
```{r metadata}

##Metadata
meta <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata.csv")

##Ground water sensor data
gw <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/L2_gw_data.csv")
gw1 <- gw %>% 
  mutate(site = ifelse(Site == "TMP", "GCW", Site)) %>% 
  rename(datetime_15min = TIMESTAMP_EST, 
         gw.spec.cond_uScm = gw.spec.cond) %>% 
  select(site, Plot, datetime_15min, gw.spec.cond_uScm, gw.salinity, gw.temperature) %>% 
  mutate(datetime_15min = as_datetime(datetime_15min, tz = "America/New_York"), 
         datetime_15min = format(datetime_15min, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) 


##Combine gw sensor data with metadata
meta1 <- meta %>%  
  mutate(Plot = case_when(
    str_detect(sample_id, "UP") ~ "F", 
    str_detect(sample_id, "TR") ~ "TR", 
    str_detect(sample_id, "WC") ~ "W", 
    str_detect(sample_id, "WE") ~ "W", 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date), 
         date1 = case_when(
           time_sampled_est == "23:00" & time_sampled_edt == "0:00" ~ date + days(1), 
           time_sampled_est == "0:00" & time_sampled_edt == "1:00" ~ date + days(1), 
           TRUE ~ date
         )) %>% 
  mutate(
         datetime = paste0 (date1, " ", time_sampled_edt),
         datetime = ymd_hm(datetime, tz = "America/New_York"),
         datetime_15min = round_date(datetime, unit = "15 minutes"),
         datetime_15min = format(datetime_15min, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
         datetime_1hr = round_date(datetime, unit = "1 hour"),
         datetime_1hr = format(datetime_1hr, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) 
  
dat <- left_join(meta1, gw1, by = c("site", "Plot", "datetime_15min"))


##Surface water sensor data
sensor <- read.csv("../Raw_Data/202407/GCReW_SurfaceWater_1hr_Sensor_Data.csv")

sensor1 <- sensor %>% 
  select(datetime_1hr, Specific_Conductivity_uScm_mean, Salinity_PPT_mean, Temp_C_mean) %>% 
  mutate(datetime_1hr = as_datetime(datetime_1hr, tz = "Etc/GMT+5"), 
         datetime_1hr = with_tz(datetime_1hr, tzone = "America/New_York"), 
         datetime_1hr = format(datetime_1hr, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) 

dat1 <- left_join(dat, sensor1, by = "datetime_1hr")


##Pull spc, sal, and temp data into columns from GW and SW data
dat2 <- dat1 %>% 
  mutate(
         spc = case_when(
           sample_id == "T49" ~ mean(Specific_Conductivity_uScm_mean[sample_id %in% c("T48", "T50")], na.rm = TRUE), 
           sample_type == "GW" & is.na(gw_conductivity_mScm) ~ gw.spec.cond_uScm, 
           sample_type == "SW" & is.na(gw_conductivity_mScm) ~ Specific_Conductivity_uScm_mean, 
           TRUE ~ gw_conductivity_mScm*1000), 

         sal_ppt = case_when(
           sample_id == "T49" ~ mean(Salinity_PPT_mean[sample_id %in% c("T48", "T50")], na.rm = TRUE), 
           sample_type == "GW" & is.na(gw_salinity_ppt) ~ gw.salinity, 
           sample_type == "SW" & is.na(gw_salinity_ppt) ~ Salinity_PPT_mean, 
           TRUE ~ gw_salinity_ppt), 
         
         h2o_temp_c = case_when(
           sample_id == "T49" ~ mean(Temp_C_mean[sample_id %in% c("T48", "T50")], na.rm = TRUE), 
           sample_type == "GW" & is.na(gw_temp_c) ~ gw.temperature, 
           sample_type == "SW" & is.na(gw_temp_c) ~ Temp_C_mean, 
           TRUE ~ gw_temp_c)) 


##Set column names
dat3 <- dat2 %>% 
  rename(sample_name = sample_id, 
         notes = Notes, 
         sample_datetime = datetime) %>% 
  mutate(notes = ifelse(sample_type == "EST" , "Rhode River Estuary (SERC Dock)", notes)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_type = ifelse(sample_type == "EST" , "SW", sample_type)) %>% 
  mutate(location = "Marsh_weir", 
         sample_id = NA, 
         old_sample_id = NA, 
         pco2_datetime = NA, 
         pco2_id = NA, 
         xco2_ppm = NA, 
         do_ysi_perc = NA, 
         do_ysi_mg_l = NA, 
         ph_ysi_nbs = NA, 
         dic_taken = "1", 
         alk_umol_kgsw_avg = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_sd = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_se = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_cv = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_avg = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_sd = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_se = NA, 
         alk_mmol_l_cv = NA, 
         alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw = NA, 
         alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm = NA, 
         lat = NA, 
         lon = NA, 
         created = NA, 
         updated = NA
) %>% 
  select(sample_id, old_sample_id, location, sample_type, sample_name, sample_datetime, pco2_datetime, pco2_id, xco2_ppm, spc, sal_ppt, h2o_temp_c, do_ysi_perc, do_ysi_mg_l, ph_ysi_nbs, dic_taken, notes, alk_umol_kgsw_avg, alk_umol_kgsw_sd, alk_umol_kgsw_se, alk_umol_kgsw_cv, alk_mmol_l_avg, alk_mmol_l_sd, alk_mmol_l_se, alk_mmol_l_cv, alk_v_crm_umol_kgsw, alk_umol_kgsw_percerr_crm, lat, lon, created, updated)

write.csv(dat3, "../Raw_Data/202407/COMPASS_SynopticCB_LatT_GCW_Discrete_Metadata_FORMATTED.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
 
 ##END
